This configuration uses the deposited 6WGL dupilumab Fab / IL4Ralpha construct
sequences. The heavy and light CDR positions are zero-based sequence offsets
from the retained native IMGT annotations, rather than IMGT residue numbers.

Source: https://www.rcsb.org/structure/6WGL

The fixture exercises local configuration review and explicit launch permission
in controlled frontend tests. It is not a calculated design, new binder,
affinity measurement or direct STAT6 antibody-binding claim. No model runs in
these tests, and no owner-machine identifiers or credentials are included.
